notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Visual Update & Bugfixes!
notes.content: [h2]Patch 1.0.1 will include:[/h2][h3]Visual Updates:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new playable area called "Planetarium", which replaces the old "Travelbubble" location used for playing different games.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a new Lounge area as a replacement for the old "Travelbubble" location.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new highlights to the "Travelbubbles".[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the flight paths of the ships flying in the background.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the "Hole indicator" for all finish holes in the "Golf" game.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the placement of rocks in the "Fourth of Switzerland" area within the "Golf" game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the lighting and shadow quality in the "Space Lounge".[/p][/*][*][p]Added new billboard ad.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred when quitting the game using the "Quit Game" button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred when pressing the "Alt + F4" shortcut.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred after a server disconnect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred during network errors in multiplayer sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred when pressing the home button in the Hand Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a fatal error that occurred during multiplayer sessions in the "Hovercraft" game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error that occurred after a certain amount of time while playing the "Hovercraft" game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error where the teleporter could not reach certain areas.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Performance Improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]Improved performance in the "Hovercraft" game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the performance of Bonus Target spawning in the "Archery" game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
